title: Arkret Realm Organization-Relationship Read Operation DTOs
description: Closed response DTO for the self-surface Realm organization-relationship read operation (ck.self.realm_organization.query.list). Returns the projected ck.realm.organization statements (active / revoked / expired) for a Realm plus the declared owning_organizations hints that have no verified statement. The verified rows mirror the canonical realm_organization_payload field order; lifecycle_phase is reducer-derived. A row here is a projection only: an organization relationship is only verified when lifecycle_phase=verified_active, and actual Realm control still requires the corresponding Realm policy / notary / capability / service-binding event. See spec/v1/zh/models/realm-and-space.md §2.3.0 and schemas/event-payload.schema.json#/$defs/realm_organization_payload.

lifecycle_phase.description: Reducer-derived lifecycle phase of the projected statement. verified_active = latest accepted statement for (organization_id, relationship) is status=active and within its validity window. revoked_or_expired = the relationship has been revoked or is outside its not_before/expires_at window. Declared-only organization hints with no statement are carried in declared_organization_hints, not as rows.

delegation_ref.description: Resolved authorization.delegation_ref for delegated issuer roles (governance_service / account_authority).

relationships.description: Projected ck.realm.organization statement rows (verified_active and revoked_or_expired), latest-per-(organization_id, relationship).

declared_organization_hints.description: owning_organizations declared hints (realm-and-space.md §2.3.0) that have NO verified ck.realm.organization statement. These are unverified claims and MUST NOT be rendered as official / governed / endorsed.
